verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant "update records" and "automate workflows", plus a REST API (v1/v2) with Leads and Organizations endpoints, so an agent could plausibly work on lead records. The pack never shows the specific end-to-end steps: no create-lead endpoint, no company-data enrichment, and no owner-assignment call. The follower endpoint and workflow-based automatic lead assignment are adjacent features and earn no credit. missing for 10: documented lead/person creation via API or MCP, company data enrichment or organization field population, explicit owner assignment via API/MCP, hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
Convert a lead to a deal POST /api/v2/leads/{id}/convert/deal
Add a follower to an organization POST /api/v2/organizations/{id}/followers
